questions.question: In the 2024 open enrollment period, how many individuals were determined eligible to enroll in a Qualified Health Plan in North Carolina?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_marketplace_oep_state_level_2024.xlsx', sheet_name='(1) Apps for QHP Coverage')
nc_row = df[df['State Name'] == 'North Carolina']
result = int(nc_row['Individuals Determined Eligible to Enroll in a Qualified Healthcare Plan (QHP)'].values[0])

questions.question: Across all states using the HealthCare.gov platform, how many total new consumers selected a Marketplace plan for 2024?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_marketplace_oep_state_level_2024.xlsx', sheet_name='(2) by Enrollment Status')
total_hc = df[(df['State Name'] == 'Total') & (df['Platform'] == 'HC.gov')]
result = int(total_hc['New Consumers'].values[0])

questions.question: Which three state-based marketplace states had the highest number of consumers selecting a standalone dental plan during the 2024 open enrollment period?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_marketplace_oep_state_level_2024.xlsx', sheet_name='(9) Dental')
sbm_df = df[(df['Platform'] == 'SBM') & (df['State Name'] != 'Total')]
top3 = sbm_df.sort_values(by='Number of Consumers with a Marketplace Standalone Dental Plan (SADP) Selection', ascending=False).head(3)
result = top3['State Name'].tolist()

questions.question: Did Texas have more consumers enrolled in Silver tier plans than Florida during the 2024 open enrollment period?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_marketplace_oep_state_level_2024.xlsx', sheet_name='(7) by Metal Level')
fl_silver = int(df[df['State Name'] == 'Florida']['Silver'].values[0])
tx_silver = int(df[df['State Name'] == 'Texas']['Silver'].values[0])
result = 'yes' if tx_silver > fl_silver else 'no'

questions.question: How many state-based marketplace states had at least 100,000 consumers with household incomes at or below 150% of the federal poverty level in 2024?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_marketplace_oep_state_level_2024.xlsx', sheet_name='(8) by FPL')
sbm_states = df[(df['Platform'] == 'SBM') & (df['State Name'] != 'Total')]
result = int((sbm_states['≥100% to ≤150% of FPL'] >= 100000).sum())

questions.question: In the 2024 open enrollment period, did Georgia have more rural plan selections than North Carolina?

questions.question: Which four states on HealthCare.gov had the largest number of consumers selecting a Gold tier plan for 2024?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_marketplace_oep_state_level_2024.xlsx', sheet_name='(7) by Metal Level')
hc_df = df[(df['Platform'] == 'HC.gov') & (df['State Name'] != 'Total')].copy()
hc_df['Gold'] = pd.to_numeric(hc_df['Gold'], errors='coerce')
top4 = hc_df.sort_values(by='Gold', ascending=False).head(4)['State Name'].tolist()
result = top4

questions.question: How many states using the HealthCare.gov platform had more than 100,000 consumers eligible to pay $10 or less per month after tax credits in 2024?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_marketplace_oep_state_level_2024.xlsx', sheet_name='(5) by Premium and FA')
hc_states = df[(df['Platform'] == 'HC.gov') & (df['State Name'] != 'Total')]
count = (hc_states['Consumers with a Premium ≤$10 after APTC'] > 100000).sum()
